title: THE COHERENCY-SYSTEMATIC DECOMPOSITION: what does the 0.313-dex curve-scatter pattern look like?
context: G105's P5 FAIL (pooled 0.313 dex, 0 outliers, systematic; r-space control 0.079 dex); G104's 0.05-dex aperture anchor; G107's a0-crossing/r_M recipe; the official X-COP T(r) ingests (G105 cache, md5-gated 12/12).

basis.residual_xcurve: log10 R - (pooled quantile-interpolated curve of log10 R vs log10 x), G105's 0.313-dex materialization
basis.c_dust: log10 R - log10[2x/(x-1)] = the free-dust normalization, the theory-curve residual (G105 V3a level)
basis.R: T(r)/T_floor(r), T_floor = mu m_p (G M_b a0)^{1/2}/(4 k_B) (sigma_floor = (G M_b a0)^{1/4}/sqrt2), mu = 0.6, a0 = 9.3619e-11
basis.x: M_dyn(<r)/M_b(<r), M_dyn = M_FORW, M_b = M_gas + M_star
basis.rM_over_R500: sqrt(G M_b(R500)/a0) / R500 (M_b at R500, G105's V6 anchor)
basis.a0c_kpc: the first down-crossing of g = G M_FORW(<r)/r^2 through a0 beyond 50 kpc (G107's recipe); A1644/A2255 NONE

data_notes: committed X-COP ingests (real_research/data/xcop) + the G105 T(r) release cache; T500_vir from the committed Ettori+19 pair; kTvir from Eckert+17 (registered table); nothing written outside deepseek_push/.

checks.name: S0 [gate: the 0.313-dex curve-scatter is reproduced] the rms of log10 R about the pooled x-space curve, 96 points
checks.reading: the decomposition below operates on THIS residual (G105's systematic curve-scatter, 0 outliers)

checks.name: P0 [the closed-form candidate gate: with ONE per-cluster normalization and ONE universal shape p the residual curve's scatter collapses below 0.15 dex] achieved rms about the closed form 2x/(x-1) * a_c * (r/R500)^-p, p fitted pooled
checks.measured: rms = 0.097 dex (p* = +0.99; 13 parameters on 96 bins; gate < 0.15)
checks.reading: the honest number: the achieved collapse with ONE shape p and free per-cluster amplitude

checks.name: V1 [the ordering property] the cluster property that orders the pooled residual (largest |rho|, with its p)
checks.measured: THE ORDERING.  (i) RADIAL first: the pooled x-curve residual is monotone in r/R500 -- Spearman -1.000 (p ~ 0.000) over the 8 radii, ++0.44 dex at 50 kpc falling to -0.42 dex at 600 kpc: the dominant pattern of the 0.313-dex scatter is the RADIAL ENVELOPE (the free-dust profile shape the x-curve does not absorb).  (ii) MASS side: among the cluster properties the residual LEVELS order by f_gas(420) (rho = +0.497, p = 0.101) > M500 (rho = +0.385, p = 0.217) > r_M/R500 (rho = +0.336, p = 0.286) > kTvir (rho = +0.294, p = 0.354) > the a0-crossing radius (rho = +0.224, p = 0.533, n = 10; A1644/A2255 none).  On the free-dust basis (log10 c_dust) the SAME ordering holds with reversed signs: f_gas(420) rho = -0.413 (p = 0.183); no property is significant at p < 0.05 at the cluster-mean level (n = 12 power), the per-bin cross-check marks f_gas(420) at p = 0.021 (nominal).

checks.name: V2 [the achieved collapse with ONE shape p, per-cluster amplitude free] rms about the closed form
checks.reading: the closed-form candidate with the phantom (2x/(x-1)) + the dust-normalization shape c_dust(M500)(r/R500)^-p

checks.name: V3 [the honest statement] is the free-dust normalization ONE profile shape with per-cluster amplitude?
checks.measured: HONEST: the free-dust normalization IS ONE profile shape (r/R500)^-0.99 with a per-cluster amplitude: the closed form closes the curve to 0.097 dex.  The collapse ladder: pooled x-curve 0.313 -> theory-only 0.368 -> +12 amps 0.361 -> + shape p 0.097 -> full 3-param closed form 0.119 dex.  Thorn freedom remaining: the amplitude freedom is the remaining thorn -- but even with NO per-cluster freedom the literal form c0*M500^q*(r/R500)^-p closes at 0.119 dex (q = -0.41 from the fit, one p = +0.99 for all 12), and the per-cluster slopes spread only 0.27 around their median -0.92 (the 13-parameter fit relaxes this to 0.097 dex, 12/12 clusters inside 0.15); what remains OPEN is the residual floor of the amplitude itself (what sets q, and the A1644/A2255 pair with no a0-crossing sits outside the ordering).

two_dimensional_form.form: log10 c_dust = const + q log10(M500/8e14) + p log10(r/R500)

closed_form_candidate.model: R = [2x/(x-1)] * a_c * (r/R500)^-p; a_c per cluster, p pooled
